---
title: "Pub 10: My Favorite Spots in Berkeley"
author: "STAT133"
format: dashboard
---

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| context: setup
library(shiny)
library(leaflet)

locations <- data.frame(
  name     = c("Kresge Engineering Library", "Cheese Board Pizza", "Kiklo Cafe"),
  category = c("Study Spot", "Restaurant", "Cafe"),
  lat      = c(37.8738211,  37.8798723,  37.8738509),
  lng      = c(-122.2608825, -122.2720543, -122.2612693),
  desc     = c(
    "Favorite study spot",
    "Favorite restaurant",
    "Favorite cafe"
  )
)
```

# Campus Map

## {.sidebar}

**Filter Locations**

```{r}
#| eval: false
checkboxGroupInput(
  inputId  = "categories",
  label    = NULL,
  choices  = c("Study Spot", "Restaurant", "Cafe"),
  selected = c("Study Spot", "Restaurant", "Cafe")
)
```


## Column

```{r}
#| eval: false
leafletOutput("map", height = "600px")
```

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| context: server

output$map <- renderLeaflet({
  df <- locations[locations$category %in% input$categories, ]
  
  leaflet(df) |>
    addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Voyager") |>
    setView(lng = -122.265, lat = 37.874, zoom = 15) |>
    addCircleMarkers(
      lng         = ~lng,
      lat         = ~lat,
      radius      = 10,
      fillColor   = "blue",
      fillOpacity = 0.9,
      color       = "white",
      weight      = 1.5,
      popup       = ~paste0("<b>", name, "</b><br>", category, "<br>", desc)
    )
})
```
